findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: safetychain_search_capas, safetychain_get_capa_activity, safetychain_search_records, safetychain_get_record_fields, safetychain_get_record_summary · Private data: safetychain_get_capa_linked_records, safetychain_get_record, safetychain_record_exists, safetychain_search_records, safetychain_get_record_fields, safetychain_get_record_summary · Public sink: safetychain_search_capas, safetychain_search_records, safetychain_get_record_fields, safetychain_get_record_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: safetychain_search_capas, safetychain_get_capa_activity, safetychain_search_records, safetychain_get_record_fields, safetychain_get_record_summary · Private data: safetychain_get_capa_linked_records, safetychain_get_record, safetychain_record_exists, safetychain_search_records, safetychain_get_record_fields, safetychain_get_record_summary · Public sink: safetychain_search_capas, safetychain_search_records, safetychain_get_record_fields, safetychain_get_record_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
